note: Pete 2026-11-07: robot outfit for the geese (player bots' Canada Goose bot, Tandemonium #611); look 'canada'.
outfit: a Canada Goose robot suit in the goose's own colours: a satin-finish chest plate in warm grey-brown with a cream lower belly plate and a round glowing amber core; a glossy black collar ring around the base of the neck with a white stripe; grey-brown shoulder caps with dark seams; grey-brown upper-arm and forearm plates; black mechanical mitten gauntlets with visible knuckle joints; a black flexible waist section; cream thigh plates and black knee caps; grey-brown shin guards; heavy black robot boots; thin glowing amber light strips along the plate edges
style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real materials. The goose wears a fitted robot suit like armour over its body: every plate follows the goose's own body shape closely, with dark flexible joints at the shoulders, elbows, knees and waist so it could ride a bicycle. No weapons, no wings added, no cape, no jetpack. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged, not covered. The goose has NO tail.
